title: Brush Up: The 3-Minute Daily News - AI/Tech, Biz, World
description:
Your daily download of the world—in the time it takes to brush your teeth. Join the working class's smartest morning ritual. Every day at 7:00 AM EST, we break down the critical shifts in AI, Business, and Global News that impact your wallet and your work. 
The best part? We keep it strictly between 2 to 4 minutes. That is just enough time to get the dentist-recommended clean and the competitive edge you need for the day. Brush up on the news while you brush up your smile.
latestSummary: Analysis of the latest breakthrough in Agentic AI and its implications for enterprise workflows.
How global tech regulations are shaping the race toward AGI.
The impact of hardware scaling on the timeline for Level 3 AI autonomy.

title: Overnight Market Brief - Bridging the Global Gap. Daily.
description:
While North America sleeps, the global economy keeps moving. Overnight Market Brief is your essential pre-market digest, designed for traders, serious investors, and professionals who need to hit the ground running.
Most North American investors miss 50% of the market story because it happens in Tokyo, Hong Kong, and London. We bridge that gap. Every morning at 8:00 AM ET, we deliver a concise, data-driven breakdown and full global picture in under 10 minutes, just in time for your morning commute.
latestSummary: Overnight performance of Asian and European markets following the latest Fed commentary.
Key yield curve shifts and their projected impact on tech-heavy indices.
Commodity price action and currency volatility updates for the morning session.

title: Post-market Recap
description:
Did the market "rally into the close" or "fade the open"? The Post-Market Recap goes beyond the green and red arrows to analyze the structure of the trading day. This daily briefing dissects the inter-market correlations that drove the session.
Every afternoon, we cover:
Macro Causality: Connecting the dots between the 10-Year Yield, the Dollar Index, and Equities.
Tech & AI Pulse: A dedicated segment on the semiconductor ecosystem and Big Tech performance.
Market Breadth: Analyzing Volatility (VIX) and Sector Rotation to gauge genuine institutional sentiment.
Closing Catalysts: Identifying the specific news and data that triggered late-day reversals.
latestSummary: Full recap of today's closing prices with a focus on S&P 500 and Nasdaq leadership.
Highlights from major tech earnings released immediately after the bell.
Technical analysis of key support and resistance levels for the coming week.
